commit.message:
Treat usages of arguments.callee as unknown callsites

Summary:
arguments.callee in non-strict mode are indirect references to the current function. As such,
make sure that call site inference bails if there's any possibility such a reference is made. This
is inexact by nature, so the analysis needs to be conservative.

nocommit until a solution is decided.

Reviewed By: neildhar
